pnl_definition: Gross trading P&L: dollar investment gains across all Two Sigma funds and managed accounts (Two Sigma Investments LP + Two Sigma Advisers LP, including fee-free proprietary/employee funds) BEFORE management and performance fees, approximated as average investment capital x composite gross return. LCH net gains (after fees) are grossed up. Excludes Two Sigma Securities, Two Sigma Ventures (spun out as Deviation Capital, May 2026), Venn and Real Estate economics. USD millions, calendar year.
headcount_definition: Average total Two Sigma employees during the calendar year: the mean of opening and closing year-end proxies, where each year-end proxy is the sum of Form ADV Item 5.A employee counts across Two Sigma SEC-registered advisers (TSI, TSA and small affiliates such as Ventures, Investor Solutions/Venn and Real Estate) in the annual amendment filed ~March of the following year. TSI/TSA staff overlap may overstate by up to ~5%. 2026 is the Jan-Mar 2026 level.
fx_note: No FX conversion needed: all fund returns, AUM, LCH gains and fees are USD-denominated.
methodology: Only one firm-level dollar figure exists (LCH net gains of $3.2bn for 2018), so most years are derived as average investment capital (press figures, not leverage-inflated regulatory AUM of $67-233bn) times a composite net fund return (Spectrum, Absolute Return / Absolute Return Enhanced, Compass, Risk Premia), grossed up for ~2.25% management and ~27% incentive fees (ADV ranges: up to 4% and 12-42.5%). Bars are wide (+/-25-60%) because full-year returns are missing for many fund-years (all of 2017, 2022 named funds, 2025 except ARE through November) and the ~$60bn AUM quote is repeated from 2019 to early 2025. Headcount comes from primary Form ADV Item 5.A counts, shifted so each filing (~March) represents the prior year-end, then averaged over the year. 2026 is Q1 only (cutoff 2026-03-31), the latest flagship return datapoint.

entities.description: Two Sigma Investments LP and Two Sigma Advisers LP (TSA merged into TSI on 2026-01-01), covering all commingled funds, managed accounts and proprietary funds. Two Sigma Securities, Ventures, Venn and Real Estate are not counted separately.

rows.notes: Fund returns used: Compass +15% and Absolute Return +15% net (Forbes); no Spectrum figure. Composite net assumed ~+12% (range +8 to +15%). Average investment capital ~$28bn (about $24bn early 2015 to ~$32bn YE2015); the $34bn Jan 2015 Wikipedia figure looks regulatory and is not used. Gross-up: gross return ~= mgmt fee (~2.25%) + net return / (1 - ~27% incentive), applied to all capital (proprietary capital is fee-free but assumed to earn a similar gross return). Gross ~18-19% x $28bn ~ $5.2bn, trimmed for an unknown Spectrum. Headcount = average of Form ADV year-end proxies 764 (YE2014) and 916 (YE2015).

Fund returns used: Compass +10.35%, Spectrum +3% (Insider Monkey, unsourced, low reliability); no Absolute Return figure. Composite net ~+6% (range +2 to +10%). Average capital ~$35bn (II Hedge Fund 100: $30.55bn start-2016, $38.97bn probably start-2017). Gross-up: gross return ~= mgmt fee (~2.25%) + net return / (1 - ~27% incentive), applied to all capital (proprietary capital is fee-free but assumed to earn a similar gross return). Gross ~10.5% x $35bn ~ $3.7bn. Headcount = average of ADV proxies 916 (YE2015) and 1,177 (YE2016).

No full-year return for any fund; only Compass -4.4% Jan-Jul 2017 (Insider Monkey). Composite net assumed ~+4% (range 0 to +9%). Capital grew fast: ~$39bn start-2017, $41bn May 2017 (Bloomberg via Wikipedia), >$50bn Oct 2017 (FT via Wikipedia), $52bn Mar 2018 (Bloomberg); average ~$45bn. Gross-up: gross return ~= mgmt fee (~2.25%) + net return / (1 - ~27% incentive), applied to all capital (proprietary capital is fee-free but assumed to earn a similar gross return). Gross ~7.7% x $45bn ~ $3.5bn. Headcount = average of ADV proxies 1,177 (YE2016) and 1,372 (YE2017).

Anchor: LCH Investments net gains to investors of $3.2bn in 2018 (after fees; single-year, not the $15.2bn cumulative). Grossed up by ~$0.95bn management fees (~2.25% on ~78% fee-paying share of ~$54bn average capital) and ~$0.9-1.2bn incentive fees (~27%); upper bar allows for proprietary-capital gains not in LCH (~+$1bn). Implied composite net ~+6%. Fund returns: Compass +14% FY (blog), H1 Compass +2.96% / Absolute Return +2.4%. Capital $52bn Mar 2018 to ~$55-60bn by 2019. Headcount = average of ADV proxies 1,372 (YE2017) and 1,581 (YE2018).

Fund returns used: Spectrum +1.1%, Risk Premia -0.69% and Enhanced -2.25% (II); no Absolute Return/ARE or Compass figures. Composite net ~+2% (range -1 to +6%). Average capital ~$59bn (~$60bn mid-2019). At low returns gross ~= net gains (~$1.2bn) + management fees (~$1.0bn) + small incentive (~$0.3bn). Headcount = average of ADV proxies 1,581 (YE2018) and 1,556 (YE2019); II cites ~1,600 in mid-2019.

Fund returns used: Spectrum +6.71%, Absolute Return -1.24%, Compass -12.21%, Risk Premia -7.62% / Enhanced -11.76% (II). Composite net ~+1% (range -3 to +4%). Average capital ~$59bn ($58bn Oct 2020; $60bn start-2021). Gross ~= net gains (~$0.6bn) + management fees (~$1.0bn) + small incentive. Headcount = average of ADV proxies 1,556 (YE2019) and 1,529 (YE2020).

Fund returns used (YTD through Nov 2021, not final): Spectrum ~+3%, Absolute Return -0.36%, Compass +8.75%, Risk Premia +11.4% / Enhanced +18.19% (II). Composite net ~+3% (range 0 to +7%). Average capital ~$61.5bn ($60bn start, $63bn Dec 2021). Gross-up: gross return ~= mgmt fee (~2.25%) + net return / (1 - ~27% incentive), applied to all capital (proprietary capital is fee-free but assumed to earn a similar gross return). Gross ~6% x $61.5bn ~ $3.6-3.8bn. Jian Wu model changes (2021-23) are inside fund returns. Headcount = average of ADV proxies 1,529 (YE2020) and 1,648 (YE2021).

Fund returns used: 'largest diversified funds' +8-10% (II, unnamed funds; no Spectrum/ARE/Compass figures). Composite net ~+8.5% (range +5 to +11%). Average capital ~$61bn (~$60bn early 2023). Gross-up: gross return ~= mgmt fee (~2.25%) + net return / (1 - ~27% incentive), applied to all capital (proprietary capital is fee-free but assumed to earn a similar gross return). Gross ~14% x $61bn ~ $8.5bn, trimmed for unreported weaker funds. Founders earned ~$1bn each (II), consistent with a strong year. Do NOT use the $8.2bn LCH figure some summaries attribute to Two Sigma (it is D.E. Shaw). Headcount = average of ADV proxies 1,648 (YE2021) and 2,192 (YE2022); the +35% TSI jump may partly be a counting change, hence wide bars.

Fund returns used: Absolute Return Enhanced +12%, Spectrum +8.6%, Compass -6%, Compass Enhanced -16% (Bloomberg and BI via Hedgeweek; two semi-independent origins). Compass is small, so composite net ~+8.5% (range +6 to +11%). Average capital ~$60bn. Gross-up: gross return ~= mgmt fee (~2.25%) + net return / (1 - ~27% incentive), applied to all capital (proprietary capital is fee-free but assumed to earn a similar gross return). Gross ~14% x $60bn ~ $8.3bn. Jian Wu affair: ~$165m client underperformance repaid by the firm (a firm cost, small vs PnL). Founders earned ~$1.2bn each. Headcount = average of ADV proxies 2,192 (YE2022) and 2,169 (YE2023; 2,215 incl. Real Estate).

Fund returns used: Spectrum +10.9%, Absolute Return Enhanced +14.3% (single source-close-to-firm leak, recycled), consistent with Bloomberg H1 2024 Spectrum +6.1% / ARE +10.6%. Composite net ~+12% (range +8 to +15%). Average capital ~$60bn (~$60bn Jan 2024, Aug 2024 and Jan 2025 per Bloomberg; may be stale, hence high AUM bar). Gross-up: gross return ~= mgmt fee (~2.25%) + net return / (1 - ~27% incentive), applied to all capital (proprietary capital is fee-free but assumed to earn a similar gross return). Gross ~18.7% x $60bn ~ $11.2bn, trimmed slightly for weaker macro/risk-premia funds. Headcount: ADV proxies 2,169 (YE2023) and 1,794 (YE2024); ~2,000 in Aug 2024 (Hedgeweek), ~200 laid off late 2024, ~1,700 by Jan 2025 (SEC order).

Fund returns used: Absolute Return Enhanced ~+13% through Nov 2025 (Bloomberg via Hedgeweek); no Spectrum, Compass or full-year figures. Capital rose from ~$60bn (Jan) to a record >$70bn (Dec; only ~$1.1bn of that from new funds), consistent with composite net ~+11% (range +5 to +14%). Average capital ~$65bn. Gross-up: gross return ~= mgmt fee (~2.25%) + net return / (1 - ~27% incentive), applied to all capital (proprietary capital is fee-free but assumed to earn a similar gross return). Gross ~17% x $65bn ~ $11bn, trimmed for missing Spectrum/December data. AUM high bar reflects the ~$80bn ADV NAV proxy incl. proprietary capital (not regulatory AUM of $185-233bn). Headcount = average of ADV proxies 1,794 (YE2024) and 1,627 (YE2025); Bloomberg ~1,700 in Dec 2025.

YTD through 2026-03-31 (Q1 2026) only. Fund returns used: Spectrum +3.0%, Absolute Return +3.7% YTD through 2026-03-31 (Bloomberg via Hedgeweek). Composite net ~+3.3%. Capital ~$70-72bn (Dec 2025 >$70bn carried forward plus Q1 gains). Gross ~5% (0.56% quarterly mgmt fee + 3.3%/0.73) x ~$71bn ~ $3.6bn, trimmed for China macro losses. Later signals not used for the cutoff: Two Sigma-sub-advised UCITS sleeve +7.4% YTD to 2026-06-30 (suggests further H1 gains); China macro fund losses Mar-May 2026 (Compass is small). Headcount: ADV filed 2026-03-31 = 1,627 (TSI 1,555 + Ventures 36 + Real Estate 36; 1,591 ex-Ventures, spun out May 2026; Venn sold Jan 2026); website ~1,700; Bloomberg/Wikipedia c.2,000 (Feb 2026) conflicts and is treated as an outlier.

ytd_2026.description: Based on Bloomberg-reported (via Hedgeweek, 2026-04-07) YTD returns through 2026-03-31: Spectrum +3.0% and Absolute Return +3.7%, applied to ~$71bn capital and grossed up for fees. No flagship returns after March were found. A small Two Sigma-sub-advised UCITS fund was +7.4% YTD to 2026-06-30 (proxy only), and the China macro fund lost money in spring 2026.

caveats: Regulatory AUM ($67bn in 2015 to $232.8bn in Jan 2026) is gross and leverage-inflated (2-3x investment capital) and is not used for aum_usd_m or PnL.

LCH figures are net of fees and cover only 2018 ($3.2bn single-year; $15.2bn is cumulative since inception). Two Sigma was not in the LCH top 20 in other years, so no other dollar gains are published.
The $8.2bn 2022 'LCH net profit' that some summaries attribute to Two Sigma belongs to D.E. Shaw and is excluded.

Fee gross-up assumes ~2.25% management and ~27% incentive fees on ~75-80% fee-paying capital; actual terms range up to 4% and 12-42.5%, and large proprietary funds (e.g. Strategies Fund ~$13bn GAV) pay no fees.

The ~$60bn AUM figure is repeated from 2019 to Jan 2025 and may be stale; the ADV-based NAV proxy is ~$80bn at YE2025 vs Bloomberg's >$70bn. If true capital was higher, PnL is understated proportionally.
The 2024 fund returns trace to a single unattributed leak; 2016-2018 returns come from unsourced aggregators; 2021 returns are through November only.
Form ADV headcount: each filing (~March) is used as the prior year-end; the 2022-23 TSI jump (+35%) may be partly a counting change; entity sums may double count TSI/TSA shared staff by up to ~5%.
Headcount from 2026 excludes Venn (sold Jan 2026) and, after May 2026, Ventures (spun out); a Bloomberg/Wikipedia c.2,000 figure for Feb 2026 conflicts with ADV and the website (~1,700).
13F-based portfolio values and returns are equity holdings marks, not fund NAV or AUM, and were ignored.
